# The essential data structure
data_list <- generate_data_list(mtbi_loc = as_mtbi_loc,
                                mtbi_mem_daze = as_mtbi_mem_daze,
                                subc_v = sm_subc_v)

    arrange_dl()

# SNF
a <- snf_step(data_list, "individual")

set.seed(42)

design_matrix

data_list

sdl(data_list)

dist_list <- lapply(data_list,
    function(x) {
        get_dist_matrix(df = x$"data", input_type = x$"type")
    })
sim_list <- lapply(dist_list,
    function(x) {
        SNFtool::affinityMatrix(x)
    })

sim_list

affinity_list <- data_list

for (i in seq_along(affinity_list)) {
    affinity_list[[i]]$"data" <- sim_list[[i]]
}

sdl(affinity_list)

affinity_unique_dl <- list()

affinity_unique_dl

unique_domains

    affinity_unique_dl <- append(affinity_unique_dl, list(list()))
}

affinity_unique_dl

names(affinity_unique_dl) <- unique_domains

affinity_unique_dl

dn <- "n"
